player_prompt.intro:
Wɔyɛ ɔkɔtɔni {player_id} wɔ Wild Tic Tac Toe.
Wɔ wo nsɛm no, wo tetɛ wo hyɛn 'X' anaa 'O' wɔ asɛe a ɛyɛ hɔho.
Wo di nkonim wɔ ɛkuo nnidie a ɛyɛ mma (X anaa O) wɔ soronko.
Wo tetɛ di nkonim afa wo hyɛn no nyinaa.
Fa '[X 4]' fɔm no hyɛn X wɔ mfinimfini.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mmɔden fɔm no yɛ bɛyɛ. Fa '[X 4]' anaa '[O 2]' fɔm no.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Ntini a enni mu: {cell}. Ɛwɔ sɛ ɛwɔ 0 ne 8 ntam.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Invalid move. Cell {cell} is already occupied.

game_action.placed: ɔkɔtɔni {player_id} de ne ho hyɛn ({mark}) wɔ cell {cell}

outcome.win: Ɔbɔadeɛ {player_id} no di nkonim wɔ {mark}s! mu.
